## Improved
- Picking a new song from Home or any list now crossfades from the one playing, while Fade when you skip is on (#2163)
- Repeated lyric lines show the count in brackets, like (×2) (#2164)
- Selected filter chips no longer show a checkmark

## Fixed
- Flow no longer crashes when a linked device on the same Wi-Fi drops off (#2161)
- Next and Previous from the notification and headphones no longer go silent before the next song (#2163)
